create_atoms_sequence_protocol: create a runtime-checkable Protocol class that defines __getitem__ and __len__ for sequences of ASE Atoms objects
implement_atoms_dataset_sequence: implement a class that wraps an AseAtomsDataset to expose Atoms objects via integer indexing
use_getitem_int_index: use AtomsDatasetSequence to retrieve a single Atoms object by passing an integer index to __getitem__
use_len_method: use the __len__ method of AtomsDatasetSequence to get the total number of atoms in the underlying dataset
check_atoms_sequence_protocol: use isinstance with AtomsSequence to runtime-check if an object conforms to the AtomsSequence protocol
